title: Policy Requirement
description: The shape a graph node stores at node.metadata['policy_requirement'] to declare the minimum policy-profile strictness it requires, exactly parallel to how an evidence requirement lives at node.metadata['evidence_requirement'] (see src/praxis_runtime/transitions.py::_check_evidence, which reads node.metadata.get('evidence_requirement'), and tests/test_transitions.py::_gated_graph, which sets it -- policy_requirement follows the same node-metadata convention).
